reviews.reason: waitForCriticalInteropCache verifies the optimizer cache, catches an incomplete-cache failure, waits 100 ms and retries until the elapsed-time timeout. Each next probe depends on the external cache after the prior wait. Parallelizing these awaits would remove the bounded sequential polling behavior. Existing cache/runtime fixtures describe generation ownership and validation-stage diagnostics; they are not claimed as a direct timing test of this private loop.
